minutes.headline: Select Board heard a proposed demolition delay bylaw amendment, with members objecting to the $300 daily fine, and set an October 11 deadline for revisions.
minutes.summary: The board ratified a full-time police officer and two seasonal/part-time appointments and appointed a bylaw review committee member. The main item was the Historical Commission's proposed demolition delay amendments for the special town meeting; members objected to the fine and some owner requirements and no vote was taken. The town manager gave her FY2023 budget priorities and presented a senior work-off policy for a later vote. The board then went to executive session.

what_happened.line: The Select Board heard the Historical Commission's proposed demolition delay bylaw amendments for the special town meeting; no vote was taken.
Members questioned the proposed daily fine, noting collection would require court action and cost, and the board asked for revisions by about the 11th.
The board will not decide on the article until the Historical Commission reviews it; a decision on the 12th at the earliest, with warrant signing on the 19th.
The board ratified a full-time police officer appointment, appointed a bylaw review committee member, and ratified two seasonal or part-time appointments, all without opposition.
The town manager listed FY2023 budget priorities and presented a senior work-off policy, which goes on the October 5 agenda for a vote.

why_it_matters: The demolition delay amendment would set what owners of older buildings face if they want to tear one down, and it may come to a vote at the special town meeting, where residents would be asked to act on it.
The FY2023 priorities, such as public safety staffing and building maintenance, point to where the next town budget is likely to ask for money.
watch_next: October 5 Select Board agenda: a vote on the senior work-off policy.
Revisions to the demolition delay article due about October 11, a board decision on the 12th at the earliest, and warrant signing on the 19th.
